meta.feel: Mid/late-1980s Alaska salvage — calendar gates plus research points, no leapfrog tree
meta.notes: Kit stays in 1985–89: hunting rifles, surplus parkas, pintle pickups, cannibalized APCs. Later tracks are rare hulks, not sci-fi.

tracks.name: Hunting Rifles
tracks.summary: 30-06 and surplus M16/AK from the gun locker. What people already own.

tracks.name: Workshop Salvage
tracks.summary: Filed sights, ALICE webbing, hand-loaded 7.62 scraps.

tracks.name: Winter Kit
tracks.summary: Surplus parkas, Yukon stoves, whiteout drill — not new weapons.

tracks.name: Pintle Pickups
tracks.summary: F-series and Soviet GAZ with angle iron and a scavenged 12.7. Gun trucks, not IFVs.

tracks.name: APC Hulks
tracks.summary: M113 and BMP wrecks on cannibalized parts. Rare, loud, late.

tracks.name: Strip Fighter
tracks.summary: One flyable jet off a frozen strip — not a squadron.
